verdict.rationale: Greptile documents several noise controls: a 1–3 strictness setting, noise control that skips low-impact or repetitive feedback, and comment-type filtering. It also learns from 👍/👎 reactions to stop commenting on things the team ignores, claims fewer false positives in v5, and shows review summaries with findings sorted by severity. One user says it is 'sometimes a bit overzealous' but mostly catches real issues. missing for 10: explicit deduplication of comments (only implied by 'repetitive feedback'), per-comment severity labels beyond the sorted findings list, independent measurement of false-positive rates.
